title: Gas-generator engine
description: A small burner drives a turbine that spins the pumps, so the tanks can stay light and the chamber pressure can be far higher. The turbine exhaust is dumped overboard.

reference.engine: SpaceX Merlin 1D, sea-level version (Falcon 9 and Falcon Heavy)

derived.note: throat from exit diameter and expansion ratio; overall length is not published

reference.note: Nozzle exit diameter and expansion ratio match the published figures. Overall length is not published, and the internal layout is representative.

flow_model.note: Streak speed follows local flow speed on a compressed scale: display speed = 0.22 * v^0.32 (m/s).

liquids_ms.note: nominal values, not from engine data

turbine_gas_ms.note: nominal values, not from engine data

parts.title: Thrust mount
parts.description: Bolts the engine to the vehicle and carries the thrust load into the structure.

parts.title: Gimbal joint
parts.description: Two-axis universal joint. Lets the whole engine swivel a few degrees so the thrust vector can steer the vehicle.

parts.title: Thrust adapter
parts.description: Short cone that transfers thrust from the injector head up into the gimbal.

parts.title: Injector bolts
parts.description: Clamp the dome, injector and chamber flange into one sealed stack.

parts.title: Oxidizer dome
parts.description: Feeds liquid oxygen from the pump into the centre of the injector.

parts.title: Pintle injector
parts.description: Liquid oxygen sprays sideways from the tip of the central post into a sheet of fuel flowing down around it. One central element does the job of hundreds of small orifices.

parts.title: Chamber liner
parts.description: Copper-alloy inner wall. Fuel runs up the channels milled into its outside and carries the heat away before it is burned.

parts.title: Chamber jacket
parts.description: Outer shell that closes the coolant channels and holds the chamber pressure: about 97 bar here, against 9 bar in the pressure-fed engine.

parts.title: Nozzle joint bolts
parts.description: Fasten the nozzle to the chamber exit flange.

parts.title: Nozzle
parts.description: Expands the exhaust to high speed. Its wall is cooled by the fuel on its way up to the chamber.

parts.title: Fuel inlet manifold
parts.description: Ring at the nozzle exit. High-pressure fuel from the pump enters here and spreads into the coolant passages.

parts.title: Oxidizer pump
parts.description: Centrifugal pump that raises the liquid oxygen from tank pressure to well above chamber pressure.

parts.title: Fuel pump
parts.description: Centrifugal pump for the kerosene, on the same shaft as the oxidizer pump.

parts.title: Turbine
parts.description: Hot gas from the gas generator blows through the turbine wheel inside and drives both pumps.

parts.title: Turbopump rotor
parts.description: One shaft carries both pump impellers and the turbine wheel. On the Merlin it spins at about 36,000 rpm and delivers about 7,500 kW.

parts.title: Gas generator
parts.description: A small combustion chamber that burns a small share of the propellants. It runs fuel-rich to keep the gas cool enough for the turbine.

parts.title: Turbine exhaust
parts.description: Dumps the used turbine gas overboard. It never passes through the main chamber, which is what makes this an open cycle and costs a little efficiency.

parts.title: Main fuel valve
parts.description: Opens to send high-pressure fuel to the cooling passages and on to the injector.

parts.title: Main oxidizer valve
parts.description: Opens to send high-pressure liquid oxygen to the injector.

parts.title: High-pressure fuel line
parts.description: Carries fuel from the pump down to the manifold at the nozzle exit.

parts.title: High-pressure oxidizer line
parts.description: Carries liquid oxygen from the main valve into the dome.

parts.title: Gas generator fuel line
parts.description: Bleeds a little high-pressure fuel from the pump to the gas generator.

parts.title: Gas generator oxidizer line
parts.description: Bleeds a little high-pressure oxygen from the pump outlet to the gas generator.

parts.title: Pitch actuator
parts.description: Linear actuator that tilts the engine about one gimbal axis.

parts.title: Yaw actuator
parts.description: Linear actuator that tilts the engine about the other gimbal axis.

parts.title: Fuel feed line
parts.description: Low-pressure line from the tank to the pump inlet. It is wide because the propellant arrives at low pressure.

parts.title: Oxidizer feed line
parts.description: Low-pressure line from the tank to the pump inlet. It is wide because the propellant arrives at low pressure.

parts.title: Fuel tank
parts.description: Only lightly pressurised, so its walls can be thin and light. The pumps do the work. Shown schematically, not to scale.

parts.title: Oxidizer tank
parts.description: Only lightly pressurised, so its walls can be thin and light. The pumps do the work. Shown schematically, not to scale.
